question: How many hours can I work per fortnight during my course?
answer: A maximum of 48 hours per fortnight, unless you are in a Masters by Research or Doctoral degree program.

question: Can I work unlimited hours during scheduled course breaks?
answer: No, you cannot work unlimited hours during scheduled course breaks. According to the context, during scheduled course breaks, you can work unlimited hours, but only if your course was deferred or suspended in line with Standard 9 of the National Code of Practice for Providers of Education and Training to Overseas Students.

question: Is there a work hour limit for Masters by Research or Doctoral students?
answer: Yes, there is a work hour limit for Masters by Research or Doctoral students. They are allowed to work more than 48 hours per fortnight at any time during their studies, after the course has started.

question: What happens if I exceed my work hour limit?
answer: If you exceed your work hour limit, you may have your student visa cancelled.
